entries.title: Psalms 58:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David.> Is there righteousness in your mouths, O you gods? are you upright judges, O you sons of men?

entries.title: Psalms 58:2
segments: The purposes of your hearts are evil; your hands are full of cruel doings on the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 58:3
segments: The evil-doers are strange from the first; from the hour of their birth they go out of the true way, saying false words.

entries.title: Psalms 58:4
segments: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; they are like the adder, whose ears are shut;

entries.title: Psalms 58:5
segments: Who will not be moved by the voice of the wonder-worker, however great are his powers.

entries.title: Psalms 58:6
segments: ¶O God, let their teeth be broken in their mouths; let the great teeth of the young lions be pulled out, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 58:7
segments: Let them be turned to liquid like the ever-flowing waters; let them be cut off like the grass by the way.

entries.title: Psalms 58:8
segments: Let them be like an after-birth which is turned to water and comes to an end; like the fruit of a woman who gives birth before her time, let them not see the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 58:9
segments: Before they are conscious of it, let them be cut down like thorns; let a strong wind take them away like waste growth.

entries.title: Psalms 58:10
segments: The upright man will be glad when he sees their punishment; his feet will be washed in the blood of the evil-doer.

entries.title: Psalms 58:11
segments: So that men will say, Truly there is a reward for righteousness; truly there is a God who is judge on the earth.
